thread:
Lina (PM): dropping a quick prototype for the invite drawer + lane-cards roles view. protos: https://figma.redwood/protos/invite-lanecards 

Lina (PM): two things i want eyes on before i hand to eng:
- SSO orgs: should the drawer still show an email input or swap to a 'Share org link' flow? option to set expiry?
- audit access: designers want an inline "View activity" button on each lane card that scrolls to audit entries. need a11y + keyboard plan.

Diego (Product Designer): my take: hide email input for SSO-only orgs. replace with a small card: "Inviteing via IdP only" + primary "Copy org link" + tertiary "Manage provisioning". show a subtle expiry dropdown (1d/7d/never) for link creators.

Diego (Product Designer): lane-cards: instead of a dense grid, use stacked cards per role with compact action row: [Edit role] [View activity] [Members count]. keeps focus targets larger for keyboard.

Tess (Frontend): hiding email is fine. we'll condition on org.policy.sso_required. pushing link expiry to backend might be extra work; could default to "one-week" and expose expiry in advanced settings for v2. implementing View activity -> scroll should use focusable anchors and smooth scroll. small snippet: 
```
const anchor = document.querySelector(`#audit-${roleId}`);
anchor?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
anchor?.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
anchor?.focus();
```

Tess (Frontend): also: when drawer opens and email input is removed, we must announce the new card via aria-live so screen reader users know invites are handled differently.

Vik (Backend): backend needs an endpoint for ephemeral links if we support expiry. if we don't do expiry yet, we'll still return a single stable join token for SSO orgs that maps to the IdP-managed users. we can add `invite.link_ttl` later. for audit anchors, we'll add audit index entries with `role_id` and an `anchor_id` string. querying with cursor pagination is best for perf.

Vik (Backend): logging plan: emit event `org.invite.method` (values: email|link|idp_redirect), `invite.link_ttl` (seconds|null), and `audit.jump_from` (roles_view|member_list).

A11y (Accessibility): a few important points:
- when the UI swaps from email input -> link card, mark the card region with `role=region` and aria-label="Invite method" and use aria-live="polite" to announce the change.
- View activity must be reachable by keyboard from each card (tab order). ideally make it the second focusable item after the main action.
- anchors must receive focus after scroll. `tabindex=-1` + `focus()` is fine. ensure we restore tabindex state after focus to avoid cluttering tab order.

A11y (Accessibility): wording suggestion for the card: 
"Invites managed by your organization\u2019s Single Sign-On. Share this join link with members managed by your IdP."

ux-bot: layout check: lane-cards on small screens should collapse into an accordion. ensure header uses `button` with `aria-expanded` and chevron rotates.

telemetry-bot: metric suggestions: track `invite_drawer.shown_for_org_type` (sso|hybrid|open), `invite_link.copied`, `invite_link.expiry_selected`, and `audit.jump_initiated`. capture `role_id` as a dimension for audit jumps.

Tess (Frontend): one UX edge: if an admin copies the link and then the IdP provisioning changes, link may become stale. show a small tooltip "Link may expire or be revoked by IdP" and surface the last rotated timestamp on the manage page.

Diego (Product Designer): microcopy tweaks: primary CTAs: "Copy join link" not "Copy link". for expiry label use "Expires in" and include readable durations.

Lina (PM): ok action items: Diego -> update comps with expiry dropdown + responsive accordion; Tess -> implement accessibility focus/scroll pattern and add aria-live; Vik -> sketch API for link generation (ttl optional) + audit anchor ids; A11y -> put together validation checks for QA. i'll create tickets.

Tess (Frontend): I'll add unit tests for focus behaviour and an e2e step to simulate keyboard navigation to View activity.

Vik (Backend): i'll draft the API contract in the ticket (POST /orgs/:id/invite-link -> { token, expires_at }).

A11y (Accessibility): small checklist i'll add to the ticket: contrast checks, aria-live test, anchor focus restore, keyboard order.

Lina (PM): great. tagging: @Diego @Tess @Vik @A11y. thanks all! :rocket:
